scoring_justification: Cannot recompute ZT from raw DFT/NEGF outputs within verifier sandbox; score agent's reported ZT_max against paper values and validate ordering trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference ZT_max values and ordering expectations for WSe2 geometries
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: J. Phys. Chem. C 2015, Figure 4 and text, WSe2 series
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's reported maximum ZT values for WSe2 monolayer (0.91), zigzag (10,0) nanotube (0.47), armchair (6,6) nanotube (0.33) and ordering statements for sigma_ph and band gap.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper-reported numbers for the same systems; needed for threshold comparison.

outputs.description: CSV file with one row per geometry. The checker compares ZT_max, sigma_ph_300K, and band_gap values against hidden references using threshold_or_better and also verifies the ordering trends (ZT_monolayer > ZT_zigzag > ZT_armchair; sigma_ph zigzag < monolayer < armchair; band gap monolayer > zigzag > armchair).

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement a ballistic NEGF solver; no specific code is provided. The scoring uses the paper-reported ZT values as hidden references with tolerance and structural ordering checks.
